title.en: An Act to Relieve Fidel A. Reyes of All Responsibility in Connection With the Shortage Found in the Property Accounts of the Bureau of Commerce and Industry in the First Half of the Year Nineteen Hundred and Twenty-Nine.

text.en:
Fidel A. Reyes, formerly Director of the Bureau of Commerce and Industry, is hereby relieved
of all responsibility in connection with the shortage found in the property accounts of the Bureau of
Commerce and Industry in the first half of the year nineteen hundred and twenty-nine. This Act shall not in
any way affect the liability under existing law of any other officer or employee in connection with the said
shortage, the discharge of Fidel A. Reyes, notwithstanding.

This Act shall take effect on its approval.
Effective, December 9, 1930.
